## Partner v0.3.5

This release makes withdrawing a message hand its text back to the composer for editing, and gives the agent and the session view a sense of when each message was sent. The main and sub-agent prompts were rewritten for clarity, the UI wording was unified across the three languages, and a GitHub project link was added to the top bar.

- **Withdrawal returns the draft:** Withdrawing a turn from a message now puts that turn's user input back into the composer so it can be edited and resent, instead of making it be retyped. Deleting the latest message no longer writes text back into the composer.
- **Message timestamps:** Each text or voice message records the moment it was enqueued. When the agent reads such a message, it is prefixed with the time the person sent it (in local time), so replies can account for when something was said. The session list shows each event's time in the reader's local time zone, the day picker uses the reader's IANA time zone, and the per-event `#seq` label has been removed.
- **Composer:** The input box grows with its content up to a maximum height, replacing the manual resize handle.
- **Prompts and UI copy:** The built-in main, desktop, file-read and web-search agent prompts were tightened, keeping the same safety boundaries (approval, untrusted-content handling, honest reporting). UI terminology was unified across English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, and the long helper texts on the prompts, settings, memory, schedules and session pages were shortened.
- **GitHub project link:** A GitHub icon in the top bar opens the Partner repository. In the desktop app on Windows, the link opens in the system browser rather than inside the app window.
- **Settings layout:** Hint icons align with their labels, and the buttons in the package action rows stay on one line.

## Notes

- Tests covering the withdrawal draft, message timestamps, the time-zone day grouping and the GitHub link were added or updated. The i18n coverage test still checks that every literal has a translation with matching placeholders.
- The Windows desktop build now enables the Win32 shell and window features it needs to open the project link.
